_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on minecraft bedrock/bedrock/egg-vanilla-bedrock.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail rewrote the install script: latest from Mojang's download links API read with jq (upstream grepped it), a pinned version checked against the version pattern, loud failures (set -euo pipefail; upstream carried on after a failed download and left an empty server), the zip checked (its Content-MD5 when Mojang's storage sends one, its CRCs, bedrock_server inside), and server.properties, allowlist.json and permissions.json kept only when they exist. update_url is null so an update never brings back upstream images. x_octail adds the category, the start detection by the UDP game port, install sandbox defaults and resource hints. The IPv6 port (server-portv6, 19133) stays inside the container's own network: each server has its own, so two Bedrock servers on one node don't clash, and only the main port is published.
name: Vanilla Bedrock
author: parker@parkervcp.com
description: Bedrock Edition (also known as the Bedrock Version, Bedrock Codebase, Bedrock Engine or just Bedrock) refers to the multi-platform family of editions of Minecraft developed by Mojang AB, Microsoft Studios, 4J Studios, and SkyBox Labs. Prior to this term, as the engine originated with Pocket Edition, this entire product family was referred to as "Pocket Edition", "MCPE", or "Pocket/Windows 10 Edition".

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Bedrock Dedicated Server installation (Octail): Mojang's Linux server zip, "latest" from Mojang's download
# links API (net-secondary.web.minecraft-services.net, the list minecraft.net/download/server/bedrock uses) or a
# version such as 1.21.124.2. Mojang publishes no checksum; the zip's Content-MD5 (the MD5 its storage keeps)
# is checked when the answer has one, and the zip must test clean and hold bedrock_server. Worlds,
# server.properties, allowlist.json and permissions.json stay on reinstall.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

fail() {
	echo "Installation failed: $*"
	exit 1
}

# installer_debian has curl, jq and unzip.

# Mojang's CDN refuses script user agents, so the download names a browser.
UA="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
get() { curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 120 --retry 3 -A "${UA}" -H "Accept-Language: en" "$@"; }

VERSION="${BEDROCK_VERSION:-latest}"
[ -n "${VERSION}" ] || VERSION=latest
if [ "${VERSION}" = latest ]; then
	LINKS=$(get https://net-secondary.web.minecraft-services.net/api/v1.0/download/links) ||
		fail "Mojang's download links API didn't answer"
	URL=$(echo "${LINKS}" | jq -r '[.result.links[] | select(.downloadType == "serverBedrockLinux")][0].downloadUrl // empty')
else
	echo "${VERSION}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){2,3}$' ||
		fail "the Bedrock version (${VERSION}) must be a version such as 1.21.124.2 or latest"
	URL="https://www.minecraft.net/bedrockdedicatedserver/bin-linux/bedrock-server-${VERSION}.zip"
fi
case "${URL}" in
https://www.minecraft.net/bedrockdedicatedserver/bin-linux/bedrock-server-*.zip) ;;
*) fail "Mojang's download links API named no Linux server (${URL:-nothing})" ;;
esac
ZIP="${URL##*/}"
NAME="${ZIP%.zip}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
WORK=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "${WORK}"' EXIT

echo "Downloading ${NAME} from ${URL}"
get --max-time 1800 -D "${WORK}/headers" -o "${WORK}/${ZIP}" "${URL}" ||
	fail "the download of ${NAME} failed (a version that doesn't exist fails here too)"
MD5=$(tr -d '\r' <"${WORK}/headers" | sed -n 's/^[Cc]ontent-[Mm][Dd]5: *//p' | tail -n 1)
if [ -n "${MD5}" ]; then
	WANT=$(printf '%s' "${MD5}" | base64 -d | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')
	GOT=$(md5sum "${WORK}/${ZIP}" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
	[ "${WANT}" = "${GOT}" ] || fail "${ZIP} doesn't match the MD5 its server sent (expected ${WANT}, got ${GOT})"
	echo "MD5 ${GOT} checked against the download's Content-MD5."
else
	echo "The download came without a Content-MD5; only the zip's own CRCs are checked."
fi
unzip -tq "${WORK}/${ZIP}" >/dev/null || fail "${ZIP} is damaged"
LIST=$(unzip -Z1 "${WORK}/${ZIP}") || fail "${ZIP} is damaged"
grep -qx bedrock_server <<<"${LIST}" || fail "${ZIP} holds no bedrock_server"

# The owner's settings and lists survive the unzip (the zip carries default ones).
KEEP="server.properties permissions.json allowlist.json"
for f in ${KEEP}; do
	if [ -f "${f}" ]; then cp -f "${f}" "${WORK}/${f}.keep"; fi
done
unzip -oq "${WORK}/${ZIP}" -d /mnt/server
for f in ${KEEP}; do
	if [ -f "${WORK}/${f}.keep" ]; then cp -f "${WORK}/${f}.keep" "${f}"; fi
done
chmod +x bedrock_server
rm -f versions.html.gz ./*.bak

echo "${NAME} installed. Bedrock players join on the server's UDP port."
